description: Activate/deactivate PFC coupling. If off, PFC cycles as usual without calculating drag/buoyancy forces or porosity. By default, coupling is on once the CFD process has been configured using the model configure command.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): accepted with on and off on all three consoles.
